integrity: No independent validation claimed. Self-contained exact-rational checker supports, but does not replace, the dimension-independent proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact rank-one B only; standard logistic gain-four entropy and arcsine law are background; full matrix rank greater than one and all chaotic parameter windows remain unclassified; independent priority and mathematical audits absent.
title: Fixed-coupling non-identifiability: nilpotent extinction and full chaos in a rank-one matrix logistic map
